name: The Poet's Sister
source:
The Poet’s Sister is a horror visual novel game that puts you in control of Kira, a receptive pre-adolescent whose older brother, Ethan, goes missing. Kira travels around her town finding pieces of poetry that give hints about what’s happened to Ethan. All the while, it’s up to you to delve into this seemingly lawful world and discover how truly dreadful life can be.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/other/the-poet-s-sister-chapter-1/32398/]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
《詩人的妹妹》是一部恐怖視覺小說，你將控制琪拉——一名敏感的青春期前女孩。她的哥哥伊森失蹤了。琪拉在鎮上四處尋找詩歌片段，從中發現有關伊森遭遇的線索。與此同時，你必須深入這個看似守法的世界，發現生活究竟可以多麼可怕。

［譯自[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/other/the-poet-s-sister-chapter-1/32398/]GameJolt[/url]］
